_what: The SHA-256 of what extract.py gets out of an original copy of Knight Lore: 'extracted' is the extractor's own output, which says the copy is the right one; 'carried' is the files the repository carries, which a right copy gives back byte for byte. package_release.py refuses a release when the carried files have moved away from these -- an edit extraction cannot reproduce. JSON is hashed with its line endings as LF, since Python writes the platform's own.
